title: Rust and Python built-in CONTRIBUTING_AGENT templates diverge
description: Biblicus on 0.36.0: the Rust built-in template includes the running-log paragraph, the machinery-chores-attach-to-epic paragraph and the sub-task paragraph; the Python template does not, so kbs and kanbus generate different CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md. Make the templates identical (one source of truth copied byte-for-byte like the methodologies directories) and add a CI check that diffs them, plus a parity scenario that generates the agents file with both CLIs and compares output.
